name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
description: Straddling the North Carolina–Tennessee border in the southern Appalachians, this park covers more than 200,000 hectares of forested ridges, waterfalls and peaks that rise among the highest in eastern North America. It shelters around 130 native tree species, nearly as many as all of Europe, and probably more kinds of salamander than anywhere else on Earth. It is also the most visited national park in the United States.
